parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records returned in this request.

parameters.name: MessageTimeEarlierThan
parameters.description: Filters messages with a time earlier than the specified value. UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: MessageTimeLaterThan
parameters.description: Filters messages with a time later than the specified value. UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. If there is a next page, this field has a return value. As long as this parameter returns data, there is a next page. You can use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to obtain the next page of data until the return value is Null, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.
